item.title: What we know about the two-week ceasefire between the US and Iran
item.summary: The provisional truce comes more than a month after the US and Israel launched coordinated attacks on Iran.

item.title: Oil prices plunge on US-Iran ceasefire deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
